description: A short 412 metre trail from the Jacobson Lake Recreation Site to where it intersects a portion of the eastern part of the Hudson Bay Company Trail. Non - motorized but good for hikers and horseback.
directions: Drive to the Jacobson Lake Recreation Site located at 45.8 km of the Tulameen River Forest Service Road. Park there and approach the large kiosk on site. On the rear of the kiosk is a large map showing the trails in the area. The Vuich Historic Trail starts right behind the kiosk. See the "Treasures of the Tulameen" brochure for more details.
title: Vuich Historic Trail
